sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to all Medicare Advantage products and for network provider services reported using the UB04 and CMS 1500 form or its electronic equivalent or its successor form.

children.title: Overview
children.content: This policy describes the reimbursement methodology for biomarker testing associated with autoimmune rheumatic disease.

children.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
children.content: NOTE: Procedure codes appearing in policy documents are included only as a general reference tool for each policy. They may not be all-inclusive.

children.title: Antinuclear Antibodies and Extractable Nuclear Antigen
content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of antinuclear antibodies (ANA) and extractable nuclear antigen (ENA) testing procedure codes for a general encounter without abnormal findings.

children.title: Cell-Bound Complement Activation
children.content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of the following procedure code for the use of cell-bound complement activation products (e.g., Avise Lupus). Procedure Code(s) 0312U

children.title: Diagnostic Testing
content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of serum biomarker panel testing with proprietary algorithms and index scores for the diagnosis of systemic lupus erythematosus or connective tissue diseases when submitted for the conditions of systemic lupus erythematosus or connective tissue disease.
